description: MIRSAD (مِرصاد) is a local-first MCP memory server that gives Claude, ChatGPT, Cline and any MCP client ONE shared memory instead of separate, forgetful ones. Facts are bi-temporal (nothing is silently overwritten), decisions are stored as first-class units with their reasons, evidence and outcomes, and cross-agent conflicts are queued for the owner to resolve. 11 tools, SQLite storage, no API keys, nothing leaves your machine.

env.description: Set to stdio so MIRSAD speaks MCP over stdio.
env.name: MIRSAD_TRANSPORT

install.notes: Runs fully locally. Memory lives in a SQLite file (~/mirsad.db by default; override with the MIRSAD_DB environment variable). Point several clients at the same file and they share one memory.

name: MIRSAD
tagline: One shared memory for all your AI agents — bi-temporal facts, first-class decisions
